title: Password Reset Guide
content: To reset your password, open Settings, go to Security, and select Reset Password. You will receive a confirmation email with a link to set a new password. If you have forgotten your username, select Forgot Username on the sign-in page and enter the email address on the account, and we will send your username to that address. If you can no longer sign in to the account email address, contact support to recover your login credentials.

title: Kafka Consumer Troubleshooting
content: If your Kafka consumer is falling behind or failing, check consumer lag first. Restart the consumer group to clear a stuck offset, and verify the broker connection is healthy.

title: Shipment Tracking Guide
content: To track your shipment, open your order and select Track Package. The tracking page shows the current carrier status and estimated delivery date for your order.

title: Billing and Payment FAQ
content: We accept credit card and PayPal payments. Invoices are emailed after each order and can also be downloaded from your account billing page.

title: Inventory Check Procedure
content: To check inventory for an order item, open the product page and select Check Stock. Stock levels update once per hour, so a recently placed order may briefly still show as available.
